lines.en: My spots shine in the sunlight

lines.zh: 长腿一步一步踩过石板
lines.en: My long legs cross the flagstones one step at a time
Wings folded, walking stays steady
My tail tip brushes the floor
I straighten my back and walk slowly
These corridors are too narrow
There is weight in every step
I pause and watch you pass
This shell is harder than it looks
I do not walk fast, but I walk firmly
My shadow has four arms
My stride is just right, no more, no less
There is light at the end, so I go
I lift my chin and keep my dignity
I stand with careful posture
My four arms hang still
My wings open slightly for air
This body is flawless

lines.zh: 我对着玻璃一样的甲壳照了照。
lines.en: I glance at my glassy shell as in a mirror.
A hundred points is a good foundation
I am in no hurry, and I do not care
I roll my neck a little
Sunlight rests on my shell
This place is exactly quiet enough
I adjust my collar

lines.zh: 完美的身体不需要动太多
lines.en: A perfect body needs little movement

lines.zh: 我低头看了看胸前的甲
lines.en: I look down at the shell on my chest
I have practiced this stance a long time
Your frame is not entirely bad

lines.zh: 我一眼能看出你的极限
lines.en: I can see your limits at a glance
Do not tense up, I will not act rashly
You want strength, and I can teach it
Standing here is a lesson too
You are breathing the wrong way
My judgment of people is always accurate

lines.zh: 沙鲁师父看着你，像看一份考卷。
lines.en: Master Cell studies you like an exam paper.
I acknowledge your courage

lines.zh: 别把我当成普通的师父
lines.en: Do not take me for an ordinary master
To learn, first learn to stand steady
Ask your question, go ahead

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你看着不舒服
lines.en: My face makes you uneasy
I will not strike first, rest easy
Your potential is buried deep
State clearly what you want
There is a mark on my shell
I step back and steady myself
This wound does not affect me
I raise my eyes to you
You actually reached me
My posture broke for an instant
I take a breath and reset my stance
Your luck is good
The mark will heal itself
I dislike leaving blemishes
I have no need for such things
Put it down, do not hand it over

lines.zh: 你想用这个换我的指点
lines.en: You want my guidance for this
I will take it, it makes no difference
My goodwill does not depend on gifts
Trying to flatter me is too obvious
This barely counts as sincerity
I accept it, and the lesson goes on

lines.zh: 你送东西的样子很生疏
lines.en: You are clumsy at giving gifts
I have noted this small thing
You bumped into my shell
I barely gave up any ground

lines.zh: 退开一点，我不喜欢拥挤
lines.en: Give me space, I dislike crowds
Your shoulder hit with some force
I will pretend that did not happen
I raise a hand, and you understand
Do not think that tests me
We require distance between us
I shift aside and let you pass

lines.zh: 完美的身体也会被撞歪
lines.en: Even a perfect body gets nudged

lines.zh: 我的同类，需要一个够强的
lines.en: My kind needs a mate strong enough
Few can stand at my side
Strength first, the rest later
This shell should be passed on
I have never been willing to settle

lines.zh: 同行的要经得起我的目光
lines.en: A partner must endure my gaze

lines.zh: 如果能并肩，路会好走些
lines.en: If we can walk together, the road is easier
I am not skilled at gentle words
A mate is also an ally

lines.zh: 我得先确认，对方够完美
lines.en: I must first confirm they are flawless enough
I bend, and my shell creaks softly
This dropped right at my feet
I pinch it between two fingers
It is so small I almost missed it
I lift it and inspect it
I do not pick up unclean things
I set it on the step
If it fell, let it lie

lines.zh: 这东西配不上我的手指
lines.en: This does not deserve my fingers
I raise my hand and it rests in my palm
I admit you have some interest
I accept this fight
All four of my arms open
You stand dead center in my sight
I raise a hand, a courtesy before the start
Do not assume I am slow
I need not remember your name
I intend to take this seriously
The air begins to grow heavy
I take half a step forward

lines.zh: 我站在这座建筑里，等学生。
lines.en: I stand in this building, waiting for students.

lines.zh: 四只手的角度都算好了
lines.en: All four arm angles are calculated
You are backing toward the wall

lines.zh: 你出错的那一瞬，我会看见。
lines.en: I will see the instant you slip.
My four hands each guard a direction.
My shell will stop your fists
My tail tip is ready

lines.zh: 你每次抬手的习惯都一样
lines.en: Your habit of raising a hand is always the same
I am waiting for you to slip
You are starting to sweat

lines.zh: 一只手先到，另一只跟上
lines.en: One hand arrives, another follows
My fist is not fast, but it is heavy

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的护甲上
lines.en: That blow lands on your armor
My tail sweeps in from the side
Four arms are more than you can cover
One swat sends you back
Even the shell's edge can cut
I withdraw and return to my stance
I used only half on that one
There is a hole in your defense

lines.zh: 我从培养的容器里出来
lines.en: I step out of the vessel that made me
My shell is still damp

lines.zh: 这具身体，一出生就完整
lines.en: This body was complete from the start

lines.zh: 有人特意把我放在这里
lines.en: Someone placed me here on purpose
I flex all four of my hands
The light falls, and I look up
I am not a thing of nature

lines.zh: 我的第一次呼吸很平稳
lines.en: My first breath is even
It is clean here, good for a lesson

lines.zh: 我环视了一圈这间屋子
lines.en: I survey this room once
Fire heats my shell until it stings
I bend my legs to take the landing

lines.zh: 水对我这个身体很不友好
lines.en: Water is unkind to this body
The blast leaves a dent in my shell

lines.zh: 飞来的东西嵌进了甲缝
lines.en: Something flying lodges in a seam of my shell

lines.zh: 这种法术绕过了我的甲
lines.en: That spell went around my shell

lines.zh: 饿着的时候，我不够完美
lines.en: Hungry, I am less than perfect

lines.zh: 雷击过甲壳，我全身一颤
lines.en: Lightning crosses my shell and I shudder

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面可以站稳
lines.en: In the void there is no ground to stand on
